title: Preflight Action Intent
description: A model-neutral declaration of an action an agent (any model/tool) intends to perform, and the subject it targets. The verifier decides whether the accompanying Evidence Bundle authorizes it. Producer-agnostic: a Claude Code adapter, a CI job, or any other actor emits the same shape.

schemaVersion.description: Full semver of the schema this document conforms to. Major must match the file (.v1.).

intentId.description: Stable identifier for this intent, referenced by the Evidence Bundle's intentRef.

type.description: The governed action class. Open vocabulary; git-push is the MVP exemplar.

attributes.description: Action-specific attributes (e.g. remote, refspec, force). Free-form object.

kind.description: What produced the intent. 'model' = an LLM agent; 'automation' = CI/script; 'human' = a person.

id.description: Opaque actor identifier (model id, CI job, username). Not a secret.

repo.description: Repository identity the action targets (path or canonical name).

head.description: The commit SHA the intent is bound to. Evidence must attest THIS head; a drift is a contradiction.

branch.description: Optional branch name the action targets.

referenceTime.description: RFC3339 UTC time the verifier should treat as 'now' for freshness, if not injected via --now. Injecting time keeps decisions deterministic.

tier.description: Optional producer-asserted risk tier (AUTO|CONFIRM|BLOCK). The verifier treats this as an untrusted CLAIM, re-checked against evidence, never as authorization.
